headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 18, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox continued their winning streak with a 10-0 shutout victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, while the Los Angeles Dodgers edged the New York Yankees 2-1 in a thrilling matchup. The Atlanta Braves dominated the Texas Rangers 15-1, and the Chicago Cubs cruised past the Minnesota Twins 6-2.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with Lourdes Gurriel Jr. (Arizona Diamondbacks) and Jeff Criswell (Colorado Rockies) being placed on the injured list due to right adductor strain and right shoulder strain, respectively. Other notable injuries include Sal Frelick (Milwaukee Brewers) with a right shoulder strain, Oneil Cruz (Pittsburgh Pirates) with left hand fourth and fifth metacarpal non-displaced fractures, and Chris Bassitt (Baltimore Orioles) with low back discomfort.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Baltimore Orioles acquiring Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash, and the St. Louis Cardinals trading for Trey Pooser from the Tampa Bay Rays. The Milwaukee Brewers made a significant trade, acquiring Lance McCullers Jr. and Colton Gordon from the Houston Astros in exchange for OF Jadyn Fielder.

top_news.title: **Rays Suffer Shutout Loss to Red Sox**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 10-0, handing them their latest defeat. Carlos Narváez led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Red Sox in 5-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox took down the Tampa Bay Rays 5-3, securing a crucial win. Wilyer Abreu led the Rays' offense with two home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Edge Yankees 2-1 in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured a narrow 2-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Max Muncy delivering a crucial home run in the game. Muncy's 18th homer of the season came on a fly ball to right field, scoring Mookie Betts and propelling the Dodgers to the win.

top_news.title: **Braves Rout Rangers 15-1**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Texas Rangers in a lopsided 15-1 victory, with Chris Sale earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings of shutout ball. Drake Baldwin led the Rangers with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Guardians 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Bryan Reynolds and Brandon Lowe leading the charge for their respective teams. Jared Jones and Gavin Williams stood out on the mound for the Pirates, helping to secure the win.

top_news.title: **Cubs Cruise Past Twins 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing a 6-2 victory. Taj Bradley led the Cubs' pitching staff, while Seiya Suzuki and Nico Hoerner contributed to the team's strong offense.

top_news.title: **Gurriel Jr. Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks left fielder Lourdes Gurriel Jr. has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right adductor strain.

top_news.title: **Rudy Martin Jr. Traded to Orioles**
top_news.summary: Rudy Martin Jr. has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash. The trade marks a new chapter for the outfielder in the American League.
